Attribution Statements: Modified by NVIDIA. The base 50,000-token vocabulary and token IDs, BPE merge rules, decoder, and original special-token IDs are retained. NVIDIA added multilingual and document-parsing tokens, including chart-related tokens, expanding the tokenizer to 72,505 entries, and modified pre-tokenization.
